title: The Champagne and Pink Roaring 20s New Year's Eve Outfit
description: A roaring 20s New Year's Eve outfit from Amazon: a champagne and gold beaded fringe flapper dress, a pink feather headpiece, a long pearl necklace, champagne glitter T-strap heels, a blush pink beaded clutch and a pink faux fur stole.
intro: Last New Year's Eve I wore jeans and a sparkly top and spent the night jealous of the one girl who went full Gatsby. So this year I'm the girl. A champagne fringe dress that shimmies every time I move, a pink feather headpiece, pearls long enough to wrap twice, glitter T-straps I can actually dance in and a fluffy pink stole for the walk from the car. It's a whole costume-level moment and none of it cost costume-shop money.

sections.heading: The outfit
paragraphs: A champagne and gold beaded flapper dress with layers of fringe, a pink faux fur stole over the shoulders and a pink feather headpiece with a rhinestone leaf.

sections.heading: The sparkly bits
paragraphs: A 57 inch faux pearl necklace you can loop twice, champagne glitter T-strap heels with a 2.36 inch block heel and a blush pink rose beaded clutch (9 x 5.1 in) with a silver frame.

sections.heading: Shop it
